attempts.prompt:
Use case: compositing. Create one high-resolution portrait-card fusion. Exactly TWO inputs: Image1 original small card is sole authority for clothing, pose, hair, expression, light and crop; Image2 mascot identity/anatomy only. Only human anatomy becomes smooth golden-yellow compact NEAR-ROUND mascot head/body, green-ringed black eyes, source-matching mouth. Preserve real source hair, brows, conditional facial hair, clothes. ROUNDED CHIN immediately meets raised/broadened existing neckline, VERY SHORT BROAD neck transition and minimal throat exposure. No separate yellow neck shaft, pointed V funnel, pinched collar, neck rolls, floating collar, clipping or cream belly bib. Preserve actual OPEN outer garment and source shirt/neckwear fastening, coherent front/rear collar overlap/contact shadow. Retain complete tilted dark frame, opaque photographic backing in its exact original color and attached lower-right cream note with faint indistinct upper marks and actual overlap. All solid surfaces opaque, alpha only outside complete card silhouette. No invented insignia/text/accessories. Fine primary details indistinct stay understated.
FINAL EXACT SOURCE REQUIREMENT: Near-frontal slightly angled serious CLOSED-MOUTH bust in dark BLUE peaked military cap with gold piping, source-visible gold front motif and small round badge area above dark visor/gold braid; exact tiny engraving indefinite. Short BROWN/grey temple hair and real brow HAIR, smooth upper lip/chin with no distinct facial hair. BLUE/GREY OPEN-lapel uniform with actual GOLD collar patches/piping and shoulder trim, pale WHITE/LIGHT shirt and DARK necktie. Preserve source-visible small BLACK cross-shaped neck decoration with PALE edging at lower center, not a plain tie-only suit. Fine cap/collar/cross marks indistinct, do not invent readable symbols. No spectacles, exact primary angle/crop controls.
Preserve exact source head angle and expression. Whole yellow area above raised/broadened neckline is one compact near-round head, with clearly rounded chin immediately contacting the very short broad collar transition, no additional separate neck shaft or pointed V. Image1 is the exact original small card; Image2 identity only. Fine markings indistinct in Image1 must remain understated, not invented as a readable symbol.
Output alpha: genuine transparent RGBA ONLY OUTSIDE the complete original framed portrait silhouette. The photographic BACKING INSIDE the frame is a required OPAQUE surface: preserve its original background color and texture behind the character all the way to the inner frame rim. Never turn the gaps between frame and character into transparent holes or a window. Keep the actual frame angle and rim. Preserve an overlapping paper note, pin or other attachment ONLY when actually visible in this exact source; otherwise do not invent one. Do not invent a new backdrop outside the whole card. Retain source clothing, hair, headgear, lighting and crop at full generated resolution. All originally OPAQUE subject surfaces must remain FULLY OPAQUE (alpha 255): yellow head/body, hair, beard, dark or black clothing, coat lapels, collar, tie, buttons and decorations. Dark cloth is colored material, not transparent background. Never fade garment interiors into semi-transparent patches, holes, white haze or see-through fabric. Keep any genuine source outer-edge alpha falloff only at that actual exterior boundary; preserve actual source transparency rather than making the subject itself translucent.

attempts.prompt:
Source-feature priority: Image 1 is the exact original small game portrait card and the sole authority for its composition, crop, lighting, clothing and visible features. Image 2 controls the user mascot anatomy and identity only; its bare scalp and smooth forehead must never erase source-visible hair.
Use case: compositing. Create ONE independent high-resolution yellow mascot fusion of Image 1. Convert the visible person to a smooth golden-yellow compact round-headed mascot with green-ringed black eyes and ONE small mouth at the actual source mouth position. Retain original hair/fur, independent eyebrows, exact actual facial hair, accessories, expression, gaze, pose, framing and lighting. No human skin, nose or ears; no second mouth, beak, extra person or invented object. Do not infer appearance from a filename or biography.
Actually viewed source-specific features: Near-frontal slightly angled serious closed-mouth bust in a dark BLUE peaked military cap with gold piping, existing gold front motif and small round badge above a dark visor/gold braid; tiny engraving remains indistinct. Short brown/grey temple hair and real separate eyebrow hair, smooth upper lip/chin with no distinct facial hair. Blue/grey OPEN-lapel uniform with actual gold collar patches/piping and shoulder trim, pale white/light shirt and dark necktie. Preserve the source-visible small black cross-shaped neck decoration with pale edging at lower center, partly covered by the note, not a tie-only suit. No spectacles or invented readable symbols.
Keep every clearly visible source eyebrow as colored HAIR at its actual shape and extent, never a yellow ridge or cap shadow. Copy the exact source moustache only when actually present; if present, it is above the single mouth, not beneath it as a beard. Clean-shaven sources have a smooth yellow upper lip and chin. Source-indistinct fine details remain understated, never newly readable symbols or invented texture.
Retain the COMPLETE original tilted dark photographic frame and rim, the OPAQUE original photographic backing inside it, and the overlapping lower-right cream paper note at its actual angle, size and occlusion. Preserve the original note marks as indistinct dark strokes in the same number of rows/groups, position, footprint and contrast; blank original areas remain blank. This exact source has TWO small compact upper-left stroke groups only: do not add a third upper row or any dark signature/writing at lower right; the lower paper is blank except original faint stains. Never erase actual marks into blank parchment, spread marks over the note, or invent readable words, numbers, symbols, new notes, panels or watermarks.
The compact rounded chin sits immediately at the actual garment neckline through a VERY SHORT BROAD transition. Refit collar circumference and shoulder lines to the mascot body while preserving original open/closed fastening, collar patches, neckwear and decorations. Cloth must have coherent front/back overlap, tension and contact shadow. No long yellow stalk, neck funnel, pinched collar, floating fabric, clipping, cream belly bib, projected human lips or extra mouth.
Output alpha: genuine transparent RGBA ONLY OUTSIDE the complete original framed-card silhouette. The backing INSIDE the frame is OPAQUE, preserving its original color/texture through every inner rim. All subject surfaces, yellow head, hair, dark cloth, lapels, ties, buttons and decorations remain FULLY OPAQUE; no holes, transparent patches, haze or see-through cloth. Preserve only genuine original exterior alpha falloff, not a new backdrop, halo, cutout window or rectangular solid canvas. Keep high-resolution painterly detail and the original portrait-card aspect/composition. One final independent asset, no comparison board, new label or watermark.
